remarks: Welcome to 15 Phillips Lane! This inviting residence is nestled in one of Darien's most sought-after neighborhoods. Originally part of The Phillips Estate, this home combines historical charm with modern updates for a truly unique living experience. Meticulously maintained and thoughtfully updated, you'll find space for everyone that's both stylish and functional. Spanning 3,599 square feet, this well-appointed home offers four spacious bedrooms and four full bathrooms, a fully finished basement to include an office, gym, play space, laundry/mud room, wine closet, full bath and storage galore! The generous primary suite features his and hers walk-in closet, renovated full bath with jacuzzi tub and heated floors. The kitchen is a chef's delight, featuring modern amenities, appliances and plenty of counter space. Imagine hosting friends in the open living areas, where natural light floods through large windows, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Step outside to explore the expansive and private lot, perfect for outdoor gatherings or simply enjoying a quiet afternoon in your private outdoor space. Additional conveniences include a 2 car garage, breezeway with ample storage and irrigation system. Don't miss the chance to own a piece of history with all the comforts of today at 15 Phillips Lane. Your new home awaits!
